title: I wrote an bash enumerator because I was sick of xargs
summary: The author created a custom bash enumerator tool called 'bashumerate' as a replacement for xargs, designed to handle exhaustive enumeration tasks more elegantly and with better control over parallelism and output formatting.
problem_solved: Addresses the complexity and limited functionality of xargs for parallel enumeration tasks in bash scripts.
why_valuable: Provides a cleaner, more readable syntax for enumeration operations while offering better control over parallelism and error handling compared to traditional xargs approaches.
